concepts.headline: 40% OFF. Black Friday Sale. Night guard cleaner.
concepts.prompt: Use the SECOND attached image only for its structure (a huge number with a pill laid diagonally across it, product below), but switch up the design: a deep midnight-navy (#0E283C) background with a soft spotlight. At the top small light-blue caps "DENTALPULSE NIGHT GUARD CLEANER". A huge heavy WHITE "40% OFF" with a warm GOLD rounded pill laid diagonally across it reading in navy bold caps "BLACK FRIDAY SALE". Below: the white DentalPULSE Pod from the first reference image on a dark glossy surface, with a deep-yellow, cloudy night guard on the left and a bright clean translucent night guard on the right. Bottom center small white text "FREE shipping + 120-day guarantee". IMPORTANT: the ONLY words in the image are the quoted texts above, each rendered exactly once and spelled exactly, in a clean bold sans; no other text, no logos except the DentalPULSE wordmark where quoted and the wordmark printed on the Pod, no competitor names. POD RULES: the DentalPULSE Pod RESTS on a surface; NOBODY holds it. Compact device about 13 cm wide and 8.5 cm tall, never a big machine. Do NOT show any travel bag, pouch, dental case or box of accessories. The night guard is about HALF the Pod's width. The night guard is a THICK, rigid hard-acrylic horseshoe tray about 3 mm thick with a flat biting surface (bulkier than a thin aligner). A dirty one is deep mustard-yellow and cloudy; a clean one is bright and translucent.

concepts.headline: We are saying goodbye (to scrubbing your night guard)
concepts.prompt: Use the SECOND attached image only for its structure (big 'WE ARE SAYING goodbye' headline, heart emoji, two short paragraphs, product at the bottom), but switch up the design: a deep midnight-blue background with a faint starry night-sky texture at the top (bedtime mood). Top center bold white caps "WE ARE SAYING" and a huge white lowercase "goodbye", then a small blue heart emoji with a crack. Two short centered white paragraphs: "To scrubbing your night guard every morning, and the film that makes it smell." and "This Black Friday the DentalPULSE Ultrasonic Cleaner is 40% OFF." Bottom: the white DentalPULSE Pod from the first reference image resting on a dark bathroom counter under soft moonlight-blue light, with a bright clean night guard beside it. IMPORTANT: the ONLY words in the image are the quoted texts above, each rendered exactly once and spelled exactly, in a clean bold sans; no other text, no logos except the DentalPULSE wordmark where quoted and the wordmark printed on the Pod, no competitor names. POD RULES: the DentalPULSE Pod RESTS on a surface; NOBODY holds it. Compact device about 13 cm wide and 8.5 cm tall, never a big machine. Do NOT show any travel bag, pouch, dental case or box of accessories. The night guard is about HALF the Pod's width.
